text:
carla: Short postmortem follow-up for the March latency incidents. We saw repeated p95 spikes tied to zone failover + KV churn. Need owners for remediation, a recurrence-aware dashboard, and a clear SLO escalation trigger.

ben: Quick recap: two-day window of p95 bursts; fallback routing caused extra CPU fallbacks in zone-b and cache TTL churned items across regions. Error budget hit ~2.3% this cycle.

ryan: I can own routing policy + canary. Proposal: small policy tweak canary in 48h, full rollout in 10 days if stable.

infra: I'll add a "recurrence rate" panel showing count of p95 breaches per 24h and a 30d rolling recurrence metric. ETA 2026-04-01. Draft alert to page on sustained recurrence rather than blips.

pagerduty-bot: Suggested alert draft:
```
alert: ServiceP95Recurrence
expr: increase(service_latency_p95[24h]) / max(1, increase(service_requests[24h])) > 0.12
for: 1h
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Sustained p95 recurrence detected"
```

ben: On cache: I'll audit TTL eviction strategy and post a small experiment to reduce cross-zone eviction. ETA 2026-03-30.

carla: SLO policy: do not change public SLOs yet. Operational plan: if monthly burn >2% after fixes, we escalate to product for SLA/customer comms. Meanwhile enable guardrails (backpressure for non-critical batches) when recurrence alert fires.

ryan: Actions (please ack): - routing policy canary: ryan, ETA 2026-03-28 - cache TTL audit + experiment: ben, ETA 2026-03-30 - recurrence dashboard + alert: infra, ETA 2026-04-01 - weekly remediation check-ins: carla, ongoing

ben: ack — will open PR with TTL experiment details by EOD.

infra: ack — created dashboard PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/dashboards/pulls/140

ryan: ack — scheduling canary now; pagerduty-bot scheduled canary at 3988888000.

carla: I'll update the postmortem tracker and post one-line status here every Friday. If any owner misses ETA ping me and we'll escalate.

ben: one last ask: can we tag incidents that repeat with a "recurrence-priority" label so runbooks surface previous fixes? helps reduce repeated work.

infra: good call. adding label taxonomy to incident template.

carla: thanks everyone. Goal: stop error-budget bleed without changing customer SLOs. If recurrence persists after these steps, we reconvene for SLA options.
